importexport_heading: Back up or transfer your data
importexport_export_intro:
The export creates a .zip file containing absolutely all
your data: recipes, photos, custom ingredients,
prices, substitutes, pantry, plan and its history,
menus, saved shopping lists, trash and
settings — to back up or transfer everything to
another computer in a single file.
importexport_import_intro:
The import reads a previously exported .zip file.
"Merge" adds duplicate recipes/photos under a
new name rather than losing them, and completes the rest
(pantry, menus, lists...) without deleting anything.
"Replace" overwrites everything, including settings and the
current plan.
importexport_auto_backups_intro:
A backup is automatically created when the
application starts (at most one every {hours}h), and the {retention} most
recent are kept here.
importexport_cloud_intro:
Choose a folder synced by a client already
installed on this PC (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox...).
Each automatic backup will also be copied there, and this
client will take care of sending it to the cloud on its own.

importexport_shared_intro: Format compatible with the mobile application — recipes (with their photos), known ingredients, pantry and customizations. Meal planning, menus and saved shopping lists are not yet included in this format. A ".txt" file received from the mobile app can be imported as-is: it's the same backup, simply renamed to allow sharing it from a phone.

disclaimer_text:
Publisher: the developer of the "Mes Recettes, Mes Courses" application, who can be contacted at majogari81@gmail.com.

Article 1 – Allergens and nutritional information

The allergens, nutritional values, estimated costs and substitutions displayed by the Application are calculated automatically from indicative data: they may be incomplete or incorrect. The User can modify them; the accuracy of the information the User enters or modifies is the User's sole responsibility. The absence of a reported allergen does not guarantee that it is actually absent. Imported recipes (via link, photo or barcode) may contain reading errors.

The User expressly acknowledges that:

• The Application is a software tool to assist with browsing recipes and does not, under any circumstances, replace medical advice, a diagnosis, or human verification of ingredients.
• The Publisher cannot be held liable for incorrect entries, omissions, misconfiguration by the User, or an allergic reaction (intolerance, anaphylactic shock, etc.) occurring after eating a dish. It is the User's responsibility to systematically check the labels and actual composition of each physical ingredient before any preparation or consumption.

Article 2 – Provided "as is" and free of charge

The Application is made available to the User entirely free of charge. It is provided "as is" and "as available", without any guarantee of being free of errors, software bugs, or interruptions. The Publisher does not guarantee that the Application's features will meet the User's specific needs.

Article 3 – Material and immaterial damages

The Publisher disclaims all liability for direct or indirect damages caused to the User or to third parties. In particular, the Publisher cannot be held liable for:

• A failure, overheating, malfunction, or deterioration of the User's computer hardware while using the Application.
• A loss of computer data, alteration of files, or hacking of the User's system.

Because the service is provided free of charge, should the Publisher's liability be established by a court, the amount of damages would be expressly capped at zero euros (€0).

Article 4 – Data stored on the computer

The User's data (recipes, lists, meal plan, photos, etc.) is stored only in a folder on the User's computer, whose location is shown on the Diagnostics screen. Deleting this folder, or uninstalling the Application, may erase it permanently: the User is encouraged to make regular backups (Import / Export data screen). If the User chooses a synchronised backup folder (OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox…), a copy of the data is placed there and is then subject to the terms of the service the User chose.

Article 5 – Third-party services and imported content

Some features use third-party services (importing a recipe from a link, looking up a product by barcode) whose availability and accuracy the Publisher does not guarantee. Recipes imported from third-party websites remain the property of their authors and are intended for strictly personal use.

Article 6 – Changes and governing law

The pypdfium2 or Pillow printing module is missing or could not be loaded. With main.pyw, open a command prompt in the program folder and run:
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
For an executable, rebuild it with Construire_le_exe.bat.

qrimport_paste_intro: If reading the images does not work, scan the QR code with another app, then paste the resulting text here. For a recipe split across several QR codes, paste all the parts (in any order).
qrimport_paste_no_code: The pasted text does not match any recognized recipe QR code.
pantry_expiration_photo_tooltip: Read the expiry date from a photo of the label
pantry_expiration_photo_none: No date could be read from this photo. Try a sharper photo framed on the date, or type it in manually.
pantry_expiration_photo_found: Date read: {date}. Check it before saving.
pantry_barcode_intro: Type the barcode (a USB scanner types it for you), or read it from a photo. A code you already linked adds 1 to the item right away. Otherwise the product is looked up on Open Food Facts (only the code is sent) and you confirm the ingredient — that choice is then remembered.
pantry_barcode_not_read: No readable barcode in this photo. Try a sharper photo framed on the code.
pantry_barcode_found:
Product found: {product}.

Check the suggested ingredient (or pick another), then save: this code will be remembered.
pantry_barcode_unknown_product: Product {code} not found (or no connection). Enter the ingredient, then save: this code will be remembered.
importurl_search_hint: Recipe keywords (e.g. leek tart), then Enter. Empty: just opens the search engine.
disclaimer_updated_intro: This text has been updated. Please read it again and accept it to continue.
currency_hint: Applies to all prices in the application. Prices already entered are not converted.
qrcode_shopping_hint: Scan with the mobile app (Shopping screen → Scan a QR code). If several QR codes are shown, scan them all.
webcam_hint_qr: Hold the QR code in front of the webcam. If there are several, show them one after another.
webcam_hint_barcode: Hold the product barcode in front of the webcam.
webcam_unavailable: No webcam available (missing, used by another application or blocked in Windows privacy settings).
